suitableFor: informational icon-card grids where each card has an icon, a title and a descriptive paragraph
product/cover-type or feature grids on a light background (e.g. insurance cover types)
'what we offer' card grids that describe rather than navigate
notSuitableFor: navigational icon tiles with whole-card links (use cards-overview)
icon + short label only checklists (use cards-checklist)
green support cards with links (use cards-help)
